notes.title: Whoops I Forgot To Update Didn't I?
notes.content:
Hey! Long time huh?
I know, I know... I didn't update this place in a while and you must be worried sick:

[i]"How is that 'Do Not Buy This Game' guy doing these days? Is he taking care of himself? Does he eat properly?"[/i]

So let's put your worries to rest - YES, I'M ALIVE.
And while I don't find the time to update, and while there is still a time until the game will be ready, I have been working hard on the game every day.
Things are progressing well, and I'm always excited to think about your reactions when you'll get to experience the weird journey I'm creating for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/963e9b8f2b4a79ec7caa2b4813c00799cf908280.png[/img]

[h1]Let's talk about the demo update[/h1]

First things first - I'm an idiot. Apparently I forgot to add Traditional Chinese even though it's been ready for a LONG while now.
So HUGE thanks to John HY Au for this translation (and I AM SO SORRY AHH-)

Also, some wonderful people in my discord decided to translate the demo to Polish!
Thank you Bitowsky, Marcin Pilarski, and Jod Emperor Kaczyński for your awesome contribution 

I hope this will help even more people to experience the game in their preferred language.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
And last and least important, I try not to meddle with the demo too much because it doesn't share the same tech-stack with the main game, but there are some bugs that kept bothering me (and new players) that I just had to fix:
[list]
[*]No more annoying noise when walking with your face toward the wall
[*]MAYBE MAYBE MAYBE you won't be able to fall down the stairs anymore?? (I don't know how people managed to do it anyway, but I did my best to make it as impossible as I can)
[/list]

notes.title: The demo is now available in Italian and Brazilian-Portuguese!
notes.content:
Yup, the demo is now even more accessible for people all over the world! 🌎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/dc02b8ec44570a3b3731ba71c724fc734428e33f.png[/img]

So let's praise the wonderful volunteers from [url=https://twitter.com/prismaloc]PrismaLoc[/url] that worked very hard on localizing the demo and steam page:
[list]
[*] Jessica Amoruso, and Federica Crepaz for their Italian translations!
[*] Erin London, Christian Mäder, Heloísa Dalcy, Jean Trindade Pereira for their Brazilian-Portuguese translations!
[/list]

They are all great at their job, and I look forward to working with them again to make this game truly globally accessible 😊

And on that note, I'll go back to programming the game so it will actually come out one day in the future. Wish me luck 🍀

notes.title: Languages Support Update (+Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
This new update fixes some of the well-known issues with the demo (such as the "jump" glitch and the notorious "I'm-only-seeing-a-black-screen-when-I-open-the-game-help-me-what's-going-on-I'm-scared" bug).
Also, you can now play the game with Russian / Simplified-Chinese subtitles and menus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/b03dbc85321d24ca1b7a56a3d7feda1bc0f5e146.png[/img]

It's been a long time coming, but thanks to some lovely professional translators that volunteered to help translate the game it's finally here 😁

So thank you very much to Mikhail Fefilov (Px-Ch) and Nikolay Yelesin for their Russian translation!
And Thank you so much to Yiyang Wang (DaisyComment) for her Simplified Chinese translation! 

The demo is now updated with both the bug fixes and the translations, and more languages should be coming in with time.

I thank you all for all the support, and I'll see you soon 😊
